# Whiteboard Template

Filename: `<date>-<slug>.md`
Location: `.eng/whiteboard/`

```markdown
---
created: YYYY-MM-DD
---

# Title

## Thoughts
<!-- optional, free-form notes -->

## Threads
<!-- optional bullets or checkboxes; direct-execute work can turn these into a quick checklist -->

## Open Questions
<!-- optional unresolved questions -->
```

## Rules

- No `status` field in frontmatter.
- All sections are optional — let structure emerge naturally.
- Add any sections that make sense.
